tagline.en: Memphis suburbs to Birmingham across the hills of north Mississippi and north-west Alabama, built as an Appalachian development road
tagline.zh: 从孟菲斯郊区到伯明翰，穿越密西西比北部与亚拉巴马西北部的丘陵，以阿巴拉契亚开发公路之名建成

start.en: I-269 near Byhalia, Mississippi, about 25 miles from downtown Memphis; the freeway carries on west into the city as US 78
start.zh: 密西西比州拜哈利亚附近，与 I-269 相接，距孟菲斯市中心约 25 英里；高速公路以 US 78 之名继续西行入城

end.en: I-65 about five miles north of downtown Birmingham, Alabama
end.zh: 亚拉巴马州伯明翰市中心以北约五英里处，与 I-65 相接

en: I-22 is a rural four-lane freeway of about 200 miles linking the south-eastern edge of the Memphis area with Birmingham. It runs south-east across north Mississippi past Holly Springs, New Albany, Tupelo and Fulton, crosses the Tennessee–Tombigbee Waterway, and enters Alabama in Marion County, passing Hamilton, Winfield and Jasper before reaching I-65 north of Birmingham.

It is an old road under a new number. For all but its easternmost 11 miles it shares pavement with US 78, and in Mississippi the exits are still numbered by US 78's mileage, so the first one past the western end is exit 12. The freeway was upgraded to close a gap in the Interstate network: with I-40 to the west and I-20 to the east it completes a freeway path between Oklahoma City and Atlanta, and it does not itself enter Memphis, stopping at the I-269 outer belt.
zh: I-22 是一条约 200 英里长的乡村四车道高速公路，连接孟菲斯都会区东南边缘与伯明翰。它自西北向东南穿过密西西比北部，经霍利斯普林斯、新奥尔巴尼、图珀洛与富尔顿，跨越田纳西—汤比格比水道，在马里恩县进入亚拉巴马，再经汉密尔顿、温菲尔德与贾斯珀，抵达伯明翰以北的 I-65。
这是一条换了新号码的老路。除最东端约 11 英里外，它全程与 US 78 共用路面；在密西西比境内，出口仍按 US 78 的里程编号，因此西端之后的第一个出口编号是 12。这条高速公路的升级是为了填补州际公路网的一处缺口：西接 I-40、东连 I-20，它使俄克拉何马城与亚特兰大之间形成连续的高速通道；它本身并不进入孟菲斯，而是止于外环 I-269。

en: A Memphis–Birmingham expressway was discussed from the 1950s, but the road that was built came through the Appalachian Development Highway System, the federal programme for roads in the Appalachian region. The route was added to that system as Corridor X in 1978, and ground was broken on the first section in northern Mississippi the same year; Alabama began construction in 1984. For the next quarter-century it was built section by section, opponents calling it a highway to nowhere.

Congress designated the corridor as Future I-22 in 2004, and the signs went up in April 2005. The Alabama section from the Mississippi line to Jasper opened in November 2005, and further sections towards Birmingham in 2007 and 2009. The last piece, the interchange with I-65, was held up by funding until the federal highway extension of March 2010; the contract was awarded that June.

AASHTO conditionally approved the I-22 designation in November 2012 on Alabama's application, and I-22 shields went up in Marion County in April 2013. Mississippi, which had to show that its section met Interstate standards and connected to another Interstate, signed its part in October 2015. The I-65 interchange opened on 20 June 2016, completing the route.
zh: 早在 1950 年代就有人议论修建孟菲斯至伯明翰的快速路，但真正建成的这条路，来自“阿巴拉契亚开发公路系统”——联邦为阿巴拉契亚地区修路的计划。1978 年，这条线以“X 走廊”之名纳入该系统，同年在密西西比北部为第一段破土；亚拉巴马则于 1984 年开工。此后四分之一个世纪里，它一段一段地修建，反对者称之为“通往无处的公路”。
2004 年，国会将这条走廊定为“未来 I-22”，2005 年 4 月立起标志。亚拉巴马自密西西比州界至贾斯珀一段于 2005 年 11 月通车，通往伯明翰方向的后续路段于 2007 与 2009 年开通。最后一块、即与 I-65 的立交，因资金问题拖延，直到 2010 年 3 月联邦公路拨款延期法案通过后才得以推进，同年 6 月授出合同。
2012 年 11 月，AASHTO 依亚拉巴马的申请有条件批准 I-22 编号，2013 年 4 月马里恩县立起了 I-22 标志。密西西比须证明本州路段达到州际公路标准并与另一条州际公路相连，于 2015 年 10 月挂牌。2016 年 6 月 20 日，I-65 立交通车，全线告成。

en: Alabama puts its share at slightly more than $1 billion for 98 miles, including more than $87 million spent over 25 years on 1,164 tracts of right-of-way. The final contract, for the five miles at the Birmingham end and the four-level interchange with I-65, was awarded in June 2010 for $168.6 million, then the largest contract the Alabama Department of Transportation had let. It ran over: by June 2016 ALDOT said the work had exceeded that figure without giving a final number, and the Alabama Engineering Hall of Fame later described the project's value as $300 million.

As an Appalachian corridor the road was built mainly with federal money. From 1999 to 2012 ADHS projects were funded at an 80 per cent federal share; the 2012 MAP-21 law raised that to 100 per cent for ADHS corridors. The Appalachian Regional Commission still lists 6.4 miles of Alabama's Corridor X as awaiting stage construction and 1.8 miles in design or right-of-way.
zh: 亚拉巴马称其所承担的 98 英里造价略高于 10 亿美元，其中包括 25 年间为 1,164 宗用地支付的 8,700 余万美元征地费。最后一份合同涵盖伯明翰一端的五英里和与 I-65 相交的四层立交，于 2010 年 6 月以 1.686 亿美元授出，是亚拉巴马交通部当时授出的最大合同。工程最终超支：2016 年 6 月，该部表示开支已超过这一数字，但未给出最终金额；亚拉巴马工程名人堂后来称该项目价值 3 亿美元。
作为阿巴拉契亚开发走廊，这条路主要由联邦出资修建。1999 至 2012 财年，该系统项目的联邦分担比例为 80%；2012 年的 MAP-21 法案把该系统走廊的联邦分担比例提高到 100%。阿巴拉契亚地区委员会至今仍把亚拉巴马境内 X 走廊的 6.4 英里列为待分期施工，另有 1.8 英里处于设计或征地阶段。

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: Slightly more than $1 billion for Alabama's 98 miles, built 1984–2016; the Mississippi share has no published total. The whole Memphis–Birmingham highway was reported in 2016 as costing well over $1 billion
value.zh: 亚拉巴马境内 98 英里略高于 10 亿美元，建于 1984 至 2016 年；密西西比部分无公开总额。2016 年有报道称整条孟菲斯—伯明翰公路造价远超 10 亿美元

figures.source: Alabama Political Reporter, 20 June 2016, reporting the Governor of Alabama's opening; al.com, 20 June 2016

label.zh: 最后一段及 I-65 立交

value.en: Contract awarded June 2010 for $168.6 million; ALDOT said in 2016 the cost had exceeded this. The Alabama Engineering Hall of Fame gives a project value of $300 million; the two figures are not reconciled
value.zh: 2010 年 6 月以 1.686 亿美元授出合同；亚拉巴马交通部 2016 年表示实际开支已超出此数。亚拉巴马工程名人堂称项目价值 3 亿美元；两个数字未作核对

figures.source: The Birmingham News, 16 June 2010, as cited in English Wikipedia, Interstate 22; al.com, June 2016; Alabama Engineering Hall of Fame

value.en: More than $87 million for 1,164 tracts in Alabama, acquired over 25 years
value.zh: 亚拉巴马境内 25 年间征得 1,164 宗用地，费用逾 8,700 万美元

value.en: Mainly federal, through the Appalachian Development Highway System: an 80 per cent federal share in fiscal years 1999–2012, raised to 100 per cent by MAP-21, with the states paying the balance
value.zh: 主要由联邦通过阿巴拉契亚开发公路系统出资：1999 至 2012 财年联邦分担 80%，MAP-21 将其提高到 100%，其余由各州承担

figures.source: Appalachian Regional Commission, ADHS Completion Plan Report, September 2013; Status of the ADHS as of 30 September 2025

label.zh: 仍在名录上的 X 走廊工程

value.en: Alabama: 6.4 miles awaiting stage construction and 1.8 miles in design or right-of-way; estimated cost to complete $235.2 million (as of December 2020). Mississippi's Corridor X is complete
value.zh: 亚拉巴马：6.4 英里待分期施工，1.8 英里处于设计或征地阶段；完工估算 2.352 亿美元（截至 2020 年 12 月）。密西西比境内的 X 走廊已完工

figures.source: Appalachian Regional Commission, Status of the ADHS as of 30 September 2025

why.en: Mississippi and Alabama count their sections separately and publish no combined figure for the route.
why.zh: 密西西比与亚拉巴马分别统计本州路段，并无全线合并数字发布。

timeline.en: The route is added to the Appalachian Development Highway System as Corridor X, and ground is broken on the first section in northern Mississippi.
timeline.zh: 这条线以“X 走廊”之名纳入阿巴拉契亚开发公路系统，密西西比北部第一段破土动工。

timeline.en: Alabama begins construction on its part of Corridor X.
timeline.zh: 亚拉巴马境内 X 走廊开工。

timeline.en: Congress designates Corridor X as Future I-22; the signs are unveiled in April 2005.
timeline.zh: 国会将 X 走廊定为“未来 I-22”，标志于 2005 年 4 月揭幕。

timeline.en: The Alabama section from the Mississippi line to Jasper opens in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，亚拉巴马境内自密西西比州界至贾斯珀一段通车。

timeline.en: Sections between Jasper and Graysville open, bringing the freeway towards Birmingham.
timeline.zh: 贾斯珀至格雷斯维尔之间的路段通车，高速公路逼近伯明翰。

timeline.en: The $168.6 million contract for the final segment and the I-65 interchange is awarded in June.
timeline.zh: 6 月，最后一段及 I-65 立交的 1.686 亿美元合同授出。

timeline.en: AASHTO conditionally approves the I-22 designation in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，AASHTO 有条件批准 I-22 编号。

timeline.en: Mississippi signs its section as I-22 at a ceremony in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，密西西比举行仪式，为本州路段挂上 I-22 标志。

timeline.en: The I-65 interchange opens on 20 June, completing I-22 between Byhalia and Birmingham.
timeline.zh: 6 月 20 日，I-65 立交通车，拜哈利亚至伯明翰的 I-22 全线贯通。
